explication: Debrify is a cross-platform personal media hub. Its documented user workflow is to connect personal media services and catalogs, browse or search a unified library, then stream, track, or download media; IPTV also supports live viewing and scheduled recording. The supplied tree and excerpts expose Android integration and native playback support, but not the main Flutter feature implementation, so the broader catalog and service branches are grounded in README statements rather than inferred module calls.
